SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
8/25
Special Branch 31 10 39
October 26, 1939.

D. C. (Special Branch)
Sir,

Distribution of Staff in Special Branch.

Now that the foreign staff is at full strength
again, I propose with your permission to distribute
them in the following manner to allow for more efficient
working :-

S.1        A/D.S.I. MacAdie.       General enquiries and
(Room 603)                         supervision of Western
                                   District with D.S.I. Liao.

             D.S. Hide.            General enquiries and
                                   supervision of Central
                                   and Northern Districts
                                   with D.S.I. Kuo.

             D.S. McKeown.         In charge of S.4 and
                                   supervision of Eastern
                                   District with Clerk Loh
                                   Wei Kong and D.S.I. Kuo.

S.1        D.S.I. Prokofiev.       All Russian enquiries.
(Room 604) D.S.    Pavloff.
           D.S.I. Maklaevsky.
                    (Temporary)

             D.P.S. Mizoguchi.     All Japanese enquiries.

S.1
(Room 605) D.S. Pitts.             In charge of Jewish affairs
                                   and foreign enquiries.
             D.S. Anderson.        Foreign enquiries.
             D.P.S.Roberts.        "      "
             D.P.S.Killingbeck.    "      "

S.2
(Room 611) Supt. Tan Shao Liang. Chinese liaison officer.

S.4
(Room 603) D.S. McKeown.          In charge of Indian affairs.

S.5
(Room 606) D.S.I. Golder.         In charge of all newspapers
           D.S. Pharazyn.         and translations.

S.3
(Room 215) D.S.I. Darters.        In charge of Film Censorship
                                  and plays.

C.B.6      D.S.I. Wittinsky.      In charge of Boarding-Houses,
(Room 216) D.S.I. Medvedeff,      licence applications and
           D.S.   Cornwell        shipping.
           D.S.   Mischenko.

C. Crawford
P.A. to D.C. (Sp.Br.)

1939年10月26日。

致：特别处副处长
先生，

特别处人员分配。

鉴于外籍职员编制现已再次满员，经您许可，我提议按以下方式分配人员，以提高工作效率：-

S.1        代理副督察长 MacAdie。       一般查询及
(603室)                         与副督察长廖氏共同监督西区。

             副探长 Hide。            一般查询及
                                   与副督察长郭氏共同监督中区
                                   和北区。

             副探长 McKeown。         负责S.4科，并与书记员罗伟公
                                   及副督察长郭氏共同监督东区。

S.1        副督察长 Prokofiev。       所有俄籍人士相关查询。
(604室)    副探长 Pavloff。
           副督察长 Maklaevsky。
                    (临时)

             日籍副探长 Mizoguchi。     所有日籍人士相关查询。

S.1
(605室)    副探长 Pitts。             负责犹太事务
                                   及外籍人士查询。
             副探长 Anderson。        外籍人士查询。
             日籍副探长 Roberts。        "      "
             日籍副探长 Killingbeck。    "      "

S.2
(611室)    警司谭绍良。               华务联络官。

S.4
(603室)    副探长 McKeown。          负责印籍人士事务。

S.5
(606室)    副督察长 Golder。         负责所有报刊
           副探长 Pharazyn。         及翻译工作。

S.3
(215室)    副督察长 Darters。        负责电影审查
                                  及戏剧审查。

C.B.6      副督察长 Wittinsky。      负责寄宿舍、
(216室)    副督察长 Medvedeff，      执照申请及
           副探长 Cornwell        航运事务。
           副探长 Mischenko。

C. Crawford

REPORT
File No. SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
Dn. 8
Date October 25, 1936

Subject Removal of quarters.

Made by D. S. Umemoto. Forwarded by [Signature]

I beg to report that on October 24, D.S. Umemoto and D.S.
Kamashita removed respectively to Room No. 503 and No. 404, the
Bansaikan Hotel Building, No. 181 Minghong Road.

As no telephone is installed in the quarters, I beg to
suggest that a message be sent through Hongkew Station whenever
we are wanted after office hours.

[Signature]
D. S.

Deputy Commissioner, Special Branch.

REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. 1. REG. STR. 8/25）
Date August 5, 1935.

Subject Removal of quarters.

Made by D. S. Umemoto. Forwarded by （签名） D.C.

I beg to report that on August 4 I removed from No. 12A
Kiangwan Road to House 55, Lane 249 North Szechuen Road, leased
Police Quarters.

As no telephone is installed in the quarters, I beg to
suggest that a message be sent through Dixwell Road Station
whenever I am wanted after office hours.

（签名） Umemoto
D. S.

Deputy Commissioner, Special Branch.

Mr Yeo,
Please arrange to have all
interested informed.

报告
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 S. 1. 登记处 STR. 8/25）
日期：1935年8月5日。

事由：搬迁宿舍。

呈报人：副探长 Umemoto。转呈人：（签名） 副处长。

谨此报告，本人于8月4日从江湾路12A号搬至
北四川路249弄55号，该处为警务处租赁宿舍。

由于宿舍内未安装电话，谨建议
在办公时间之后若需找我，请通过狄思威路站传话。

（签名） Umemoto
